title: 秋華賞の後に・1歩、再び

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Mejiro Dober wasn't able to win the Triple Tiara, she feels a sense of accomplishment after running with all her strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For the sake of her supporters, Mejiro Dober vows not to cry and instead marches on straight into her next challenge!
